t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup. Top-left: a deep navy block bleeding off the top and left edges, holding a small label over a hairline rule and a huge two-line light-weight sans headline cropped by the left frame edge. Below on warm limestone: a three-column hairline table with mono row numbers and bracketed uppercase mono labels comparing two columns for <CONTENT>, running off the bottom edge. At right, in open limestone space, one simple navy hairline line drawing of a closed water loop with a tank and a valve. Flat, square corners.
signature_idea: A headline block cropped by the frame shouts the comparison, then a plain two-column table answers it beside a lone loop drawing.
strengths: huge headline block gives strong editorial entry
comparison table is clear and readable
mono row numbers and labels fit the system
weaknesses: mostly a plain table with a headline, little visual idea
headline weight is regular, not light, so it reads heavy
loop drawing is crude and disconnected from the table
bracketed labels misuse placeholder brackets for real row names
brand_fit_why: Palette and mono table fit, but the heavy headline, crude loop and plain table make it louder and less precise than the brand.
